The model sounds capable

The maintenance packet still fails.

The model can write. It cannot locate the active work order, verify asset identity, use the approved system, or name the person who owns the decision.

Instructor explanation

Agent anatomy is a functional teaching model. The parts do not need to be separate products. They represent jobs the system must perform: understand the goal, follow instructions, use evidence, select tools, retain task state, respect permissions, evaluate outcomes, and stop for a person.

When the system fails, do not immediately ask for a larger model. Find the missing function first.
